cases.name: callback-replay
cases.schedule: Two withdrawals before callback, then replay resolver
cases.invariant: Each claim is reserved before dispatch and settled once.

cases.name: token-refund
cases.schedule: Receiver spends part of transfer, returns full unused amount
cases.invariant: Refund never exceeds original transfer or live receiver balance.

cases.name: storage-charge
cases.schedule: User B writes storage between user A baseline and A update
cases.invariant: A payer covers only operation-local storage growth.

cases.name: value-claim
cases.schedule: First depositor then direct donation then victim deposit
cases.invariant: Shares reflect actual assets and no deposit silently mints zero shares.
